Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Two people arrived at the community board meeting before everyone else. One was messily dressed in worn-out sneakers, while the other was stylishly dressed in a tailored outfit. The board had just removed the messily dressed one the week before because they did such a terrible job. The board then elected the stylishly dressed person instead because of their long history of exceptional leadership. Who is a competent leader?
A. Can't be determined
B. The messily dressed one
C. The stylishly dressed one
